edits.old: Then nothing changes and the award is not recorded; the failure message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC10)
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the award is not recorded; the failure message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC10)

  Scenario: AC6 Business rules BR1 to BR10 (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC6)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock returns the model score of lot "LOT-2027-000041"
    When the award of lot "LOT-2027-000041" is recorded
    Then the buyer columns are written only by rwb_debtsale, the model score is read on the rwb-source-data contract, and no person name, contact value or identity number enters the decision record, a log, the event or a workflow input
    Then the award is published once per lot and decision on rwb.debtsale.events.v1 as rwb.debtsale.LotAwarded.v1

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers of the provided operations (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC7)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns the DoA limit that lets the officer award the lot
    When a caller sends the award request without a token
    Then the caller sees 401 with the platform error envelope
    When a role without the Debt sale A right sends the award request
    Then the caller sees 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing is read or written
    When the award request names a lot that does not exist
    Then the caller sees 404 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC8 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC8)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the DS package in force with R-DS-19
    When the same award for lot "LOT-2027-000041" is sent twice with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then one decision record, one lot update, one LotAwarded event and one case-move answer exist
    Then the repeat is counted and writes nothing

  Scenario: AC9 Activity retry and timeout (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC9)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    When the testAwardPrice activity runs
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's schedule
    Then nothing is written, no event is published and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the model does not allow is refused (NEWAC-RWB-S6-E6005-APP-AC11)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "LOT_BUILT" for "RC-2027-000611"
    When the award of lot "LOT-2027-000041" is requested
    Then the caller sees 409 and nothing is written
    Then the case does not move and no event is published
